doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: As a user, I want to see all partitions in a grid view with selection checkboxes, so that I can select partitions to backup or flash. Grid should handle 100+ partitions with virtual scrolling.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: All feature components follow standard structure with hooks at top, derived state, handlers, and render. Use cn() utility for className merging.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Feature components go in src/components/features/{domain}/ directory. Partition components should be in src/components/features/partition/

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Users need to select partitions from a grid view for backup and flash operations. Dangerous partitions should be clearly marked with warnings.

doc.title: Previous Story - Connection Flow
doc.snippet: Partition reading implemented successfully. Hardware tested on Find X7 Ultra (145 partitions) and OnePlus Ace 5 (141 partitions). Partitions stored in partitionStore via setPartitions().

artifact.reason: Existing partition store with partitions array and selection state. Need to enhance with selection actions (toggleSelection, selectAll, deselectAll already exist).
Partition data structure with name, startSector, endSector, sizeInSectors, sizeFormatted, typeGuid, uniqueGuid, attributes.
Core logic for partition operations. DO NOT MODIFY - only reference for understanding partition data structure.
Hook that wraps FirehoseProtocol and provides getPartitionTable() method. Used by Story 2.5 to populate partitionStore.

node.note: For virtual scrolling when partitions > 100. Need to install: npm install react-window @types/react-window

constraint.rule: Follow Component Pattern from architecture.md: hooks at top, derived state, handlers, render
Use cn() utility from @/lib/utils for className merging
partitionStore already has toggleSelection, selectAll, deselectAll actions - use them directly
Selection state uses Set<string> for efficient lookup
DO NOT modify any files in src/core/, src/auth/, src/services/ - these are preserved
Implement virtual scrolling for partitions.length > 100 using react-window
Memoize expensive components and use useCallback for handlers
All user-facing text must use t() from useTranslation hook
Use Tailwind CSS utilities for all styling
Use shadcn/ui components (Checkbox, Button, Card) for UI elements
Protected partitions list: abl, xbl, boot, recovery, modem, persist, vendor_boot, dtbo, vbmeta, vbmeta_system

tests.standards: Testing standards: Use Vitest + React Testing Library for component tests. Test files should be co-located with components as {ComponentName}.test.tsx. Focus on user interactions and accessibility. For this story, testing is verification-based (manual testing with real device) rather than automated unit tests.
tests.locations: - src/components/**/*.test.tsx (component tests) - src/hooks/**/*.test.ts (hook tests) - src/stores/**/*.test.ts (store tests)
